     ORDER ADOPTING THE REPORT AND RECOMMENDATION 
          AND REMANDING THIS CASE TO STATE COURT 
 Plaintiff Mildred Metts (Metts), who is representing herself, filed this civil action against 
Defendant Allstate Indemnity Company (Allstate).  Metts initially filed the action in the Richland 
County Court of Common Pleas, but Allstate removed it to this Court. 
 This matter is before the Court for review of the Report and Recommendation (Report) of 
the United States Magistrate Judge recommending the Court remand this case for lack of subject 
matter jurisdiction.  The Report was made in accordance with 28 U.S.C.§ 636 and Local Civil 
Rule 73.02 for the District of South Carolina. 
 The Magistrate Judge makes only a recommendation to this Court.  The recommendation 
has no presumptive weight.  The responsibility to make a final determination remains with the 
Court. Mathews v. Weber, 423 U.S. 261, 270 (1976).  The Court is charged with making a de novo 
determination of those portions of the Report to which specific objection is made, and the Court 
may accept, reject, or modify, in whole or in part, the recommendation of the Magistrate Judge or 
recommit the matter with instructions.  28 U.S.C.§ 636(b)(1). 

The Magistrate Judge filed the Report on August 25, 2025.  To date, the parties have failed 
to file any objections.                                                   
“[I]n the absence of a timely filed objection, a district court need not conduct a de novo 
review[] but instead must ‘only satisfy itself that there is no clear error on the face of the record in 

order to accept the recommendation.’”  Diamond v. Colonial Life & Accident Ins. Co., 416 F.3d 
310, 315 (4th Cir. 2005).  Moreover, a failure to object waives appellate review.  Wright v. Collins, 
766 F.2d 841, 845–46 (4th Cir. 1985).                                     
After a thorough review of the Report and record in these cases under the standard set forth 
above, the Court adopts the Report and incorporates it herein.  Therefore, it is the judgment of the 
Court this case is REMANDED to the Richland County Court of Common Pleas. 
IT IS SO ORDERED.                                                    
Signed this 6th day of October 2025, in Columbia, South Carolina.    
                              s/ Mary Geiger Lewis                          
                              MARY GEIGER LEWIS                      
                              UNITED STATES DISTRICT JUDGE           


                         *****                                       
               NOTICE OF RIGHT TO APPEAL                             

The parties are hereby notified of their right to appeal this Order within thirty days from 
the date hereof, pursuant to Rules 3 and 4 of the Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure.
